items.title: 2akouwu/reverify
items.excerpt: Stop your AI from making things up — it proposes, deterministic tools decide, every claim checked against ground truth with evidence. Grounded facts and context survive resets. Reverse engineering is the proving ground. MCP server + CLI.
items.summary: Authors propose deterministic verification layer where AI proposals are checked against ground truth via evidence-based tools; includes MCP server and CLI implementation for preventing hallucination.
items.usefulness: Could be adapted to validate document analysis outputs by requiring external tool confirmation before accepting AI-generated claims.
items.to_verify: Whether deterministic tools genuinely prevent hallucination or merely flag uncertain outputs; how evidence requirements affect latency.

items.title: It's Time to Investigate the AI Labs
items.summary: Cal Newport argues AI labs require regulatory investigation; discusses governance gaps in corporate AI development.
items.usefulness: Might frame critical questions about AI governance structures when evaluating which tools and frameworks align with responsible deployment principles.
items.to_verify: Specific governance failures Newport identifies; whether arguments rely on hypothetical risks versus documented incidents.
